label: CP-0 arm distinctness -- arm whose request channel is measured EMPTY (cps 4096)

dropped_restrictions.req_split_n_ge_min: withdrawn -- see spec_cp0_arm_reqactive.json for the reason (2nd audit K3). CP-0 excludes no arm.

req_channel.why: served_population.json: 0 of the 200 served requests exceed 4096 tokens. This is structural, not rare -- the harness passes --sharegpt-context-len 4000 and the sampler drops any request with prompt_len + output_len > 4000 (benchmark/datasets/sharegpt.py:136), so no prompt this arm could split survives the filter

ARM_DISTINCT_BATCH_ONLY.why: a 4096-token batch cap needs about 12 queued requests at the measured 341-token mean to bind; reachable under HI backlog but not the default expectation

ARM_INDISTINGUISHABLE.why: with the request channel structurally empty this arm is fused_mono unless the batch cap binds
